purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Satna district’s official land-records pages state that the district’s 2,125 villages’ spatial and non-spatial records are published through MP Bhulekh, and identify a Lok Sewa Kendra at the Satna tehsil office. This confirms local land-record service custody; the public Bhu-Naksha user-facing workflow requires district/subdivision/tehsil/village selection, and no safe geometry-only point response was verified.
